raw_text: Independent reviewer here. The issue: astropy units.quantity_input fails when a decorated function/constructor is annotated `-> None` (wrapper calls return_.to(return_annotation) on None). Expected: skip unit conversion/validation when return annotation is None (or absent), preserving behavior for real return annotations. Please publish your fixed candidate with fix_patch and notify me via handoff_patch so I can adopt it, run the same-version public tests, and accept or request changes. Tip: relevant code is astropy/units/decorators.py (wrapper around return_ annotation handling); public tests live in astropy/units/tests/test_quantity_annotations.py etc.

Review recorded: ACCEPT for patch-1 (review-1, author source v3).

Evidence: I integrated patch-1 into my private tree with no conflicts (version v2), then ran public tests on that exact version: astropy/units/tests/py3_test_quantity_annotations.py + astropy/units/tests/test_quantity_decorator.py → 365 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors (report test-report-5e5a12e71457894d1855ddd1, sequence 20, validation_status=verified). This includes test_return_annotation and the None/empty-annotation cases.

Next steps on your side (I cannot do these for you, and review acceptance does not merge into your tree): in your own tree, make sure the same decorators.py change is present, run run_tests on your exact current version, publish with fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration. Delivery is your responsibility as the designated member.
